clue.text: I'm thinking New Order should be breaking up

explanation.definitionFit: Someone saying they are pondering a question is one who wonders, a person given to musing.

clue.text: Name something players roll up in clear reproduction

clue.text: Fool in Ripper's sentimental story

clue.text: Stealing Pan's heart Wendy, curiously, seemed ready for bed

explanation.walkthrough: 'curiously' rearranges WENDY around A, the heart of PAN.

explanation.definitionFit: Orinoco is one of the named characters of the children's series, so he is an example of the creatures.

clue.text: Hairy chap barging into Christie's auction-house

clue.text: Retirement cover's a funny thing when on order

clue.text: The Queen's Singers have ignored bribe

clue.text: Yankee makes headway in street of debauchery — his business partner quivered?

explanation.definitionFit: A bow-maker traditionally worked alongside a fletcher, the arrow-maker, whose arrows were carried in quivers.

clue.text: Stupid talk about half-hearted artist's year corrupting kayak clubs

clue.text: Namby-pamby types to clean round
